description: This file defines the PHP client class for interacting with the Amazon Pinpoint SMS Voice V2 AWS service. It includes method annotations for various service operations, indicating whether they are synchronous or asynchronous, and extends the base AwsClient class.

classes.name: PinpointSMSVoiceV2Client
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the Amazon Pinpoint SMS Voice V2 service, providing methods for various operations as indicated by annotations.

methods.name: associateOriginationIdentity
methods.description: Associates an origination identity with the service.

methods.name: associateOriginationIdentityAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates an origination identity with the service.
